name: Remote-racking drive interface
summary: Shows the command and feedback connection of a manufacturer-provided racking drive.
description: Shows the command and feedback connection of a manufacturer-provided racking drive. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Racking command and readiness” at the input and “Racking-drive action” at the output. Remote operation does not remove equipment interlocks.
